category.description: Claim findings: contradicted_claim | unsupported_claim | supported_claim | engine_error. Rule findings (check_type 'rule'): terminology | brand_compliance | accessibility. 'stub' marks the no-provider placeholder. Null only on findings written before categories were filled.

span.description: Half-open [start, end) Unicode code point offsets into the content version's text.

suggested_correction.description: The whole original_text rewritten (the UI swaps it in with draft.replace). Only ever a suggestion; never applied automatically and never changes verification_status.

rule_id.description: Rule findings only: the brand rule (or built-in accessibility check, e.g. style.caps) that produced it. Null on claim findings.

rule_type.description: Rule findings only: e.g. prohibited_term, required_disclaimer, all_caps_run (inkloom_verify RuleType).

scope.description: Rule findings only. text: the span is the offending text. document: something is missing (a required term, a disclaimer); the span anchors on the first line.

suggestion_basis.description: Rule findings with a suggested_correction: why it may be offered.

source_ids.description: Rule findings only: the approved documents the rule is quoted from (also in evidence).

safer_wording.description: Unverified claims only: a softened wording that is NOT evidence-backed (label it so). The whole original_text rewritten, like suggested_correction, which stays evidence-backed only.

source_title.description: Title of the cited brand document.

source_version_number.description: Version of that document the quote was taken from.
